title: Home Comfort Financing Plan Rate Sheet
content:
Home Comfort Financing is offered under six plans. Each plan carries one rate type — promotional or fixed — and the rates and promotional terms below.

## Rates by plan

| Plan | Rate type | Contract APR (before any autopay reduction) | Deferred interest | Deferred-interest APR | Promotional period | APR after the promotional period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan | promotional | 0.00% | yes | 26.99% | 12 months | 26.99% |
| 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | promotional | 0.00% | no | 0.00% | 18 months | 17.99% |
| 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | promotional | 0.00% | no | 0.00% | 36 months | 17.99% |
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | fixed | 5.99% | no | 0.00% | 0 months | 0.00% |
| 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | fixed | 7.99% | no | 0.00% | 0 months | 0.00% |
| 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | fixed | 9.99% | no | 0.00% | 0 months | 0.00% |

The promotional period runs from funding. A deferred-interest APR of 0.00% means the plan is not a deferred-interest plan; a promotional period of 0 months and a post-promotional APR of 0.00% mean the plan is fixed-rate and has no promotion.

## Accrual and promotional terms by plan

| Plan | How interest accrues | What is assessed if the promotional balance is not paid by the end of the promotion | Balance left at the end of an equal-payment promotion | Reminder of the remaining promotional balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan | daily simple interest on the daily principal balance, 365-day year | all interest accrued from the funded date on the daily promotional balance at the plan's deferred-interest APR | not applicable | 60 calendar days before the promotional end date |
| 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | daily simple interest on the daily principal balance, 365-day year | not applicable | accrues the post-promotional APR from the day after the promotional end date | 60 calendar days before the promotional end date |
| 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | daily simple interest on the daily principal balance, 365-day year | not applicable | accrues the post-promotional APR from the day after the promotional end date | 60 calendar days before the promotional end date |
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | daily simple interest on the daily principal balance, 365-day year | not applicable | not applicable | none (0 days) |
| 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | daily simple interest on the daily principal balance, 365-day year | not applicable | not applicable | none (0 days) |
| 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | daily simple interest on the daily principal balance, 365-day year | not applicable | not applicable | none (0 days) |

## Reading the sheet

- **Same-As-Cash versus Equal Payment.** Both 0% APR promotions show a contract APR of 0.00%. Only the 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan carries deferred interest: on that plan interest builds at 26.99% from the funded date during the promotion. On the 18-Month and 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plans nothing is deferred.
- **Fixed-rate plans.** The 60-Month, 120-Month and 144-Month plans have a rate type of fixed, no promotional period, no deferred interest, no post-promotional APR and no promotional reminder; their contract APR is 5.99%, 7.99% and 9.99% respectively.
- **The contract APR is quoted before any autopay reduction.**
